blocks: Your home could take you places
Home / Away
What you lend, and what you borrow.
On the slider at the top of the page, Home is the house you offer and Away is the home it could be exchanged with. The trade is in weeks, not money.
Different ways to exchange
Three ways it can work.
The arrangements differ in one thing above all: whether both households have to travel at the same time.
How does it work?
From first message to handing back the keys.
Eight stages, each marked as what this page could establish or what you need to confirm for yourself.
01 Finding an exchange
Through a membership platform, which handles the introductions and the profiles. PlotNua does not arrange exchanges.

03 Matching
